title: CRWV, NBIS, IREN Stocks Tumble After Gartner Forecasts 80% Of Neocloud Market Will Cease To Exist By 2030
key_facts: Gartner released a report on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026 saying tech firms risk writing off more than $3.5 trillion of AI infrastructure by the end of 2030.
Gartner expects over 80% of neocloud providers to cease independent operations by 2030.
AI providers are on track to invest nearly $1 trillion in 2026 and another $6 trillion through 2030.
Gartner projects AI-attributable revenue will cap out at roughly $3.6 trillion in that period.
Neocloud firms lease specialised GPUs and rely almost entirely on AI infrastructure-service margins.
CoreWeave shares plunged by up to 17% on Wednesday; its CEO called the market 'irrational'.
Nebius is up 120% and CoreWeave down 11% so far this year (Stocktwits).
quote_evidence: Enterprise and consumer AI revenue will be insufficient to support profitable returns on all planned AI capital expenditures during this period," said Will Sommer, senior director analyst at Gartner.
Gartner predicts that over 80% of independent neocloud operators will be forced to shut down or merge by 2030.
why_it_matters_hint: A respected research firm is questioning whether AI computing renters can earn back their investment.
